title: Project + Timesheet + Analytic Time-Cost Chain
phase: Second-Pass Depth Closure — P2 Supporting Domains

key_findings.timesheet_model: account.analytic.line (defined in analytic addon, extended by hr_timesheet)
key_findings.timesheet_fields: unit_amount (hours), amount (cost, negative), date, name, project_id, task_id, employee_id, account_id (from analytic plan mixin), milestone_id (related)
key_findings.analytic_plan_structure: account.analytic.plan hierarchy; project plan identified by ir.config_parameter 'analytic.project_plan'; project plan → column 'account_id'; other plans → dynamic columns 'x_plan{id}_id'
key_findings.project_analytic_linkage: project.project.account_id (Many2one to account.analytic.account); auto-created on project create when allow_timesheets=True and no account_id provided
key_findings.cost_computation: amount = -(unit_amount × employee.hourly_cost); triggered on changes to unit_amount, employee_id, account_id; employee.hourly_cost from hr_hourly_cost addon; converted from employee currency to account currency
key_findings.sale_timesheet_presence: sale_timesheet module present in Community; adds so_line, timesheet_invoice_type, timesheet_invoice_id to analytic lines; three pricing types: task_rate, fixed_rate, employee_rate
key_findings.invoice_trigger: qty_delivered_method='timesheet' on SOL for service products with service_type=timesheet; SOL qty_delivered aggregated from timesheet unit_amount; invoice created from sale order via standard SO invoicing flow
key_findings.milestone_billing: project.milestone model present in Community; billing type 'billable_milestones' recognized in sale_timesheet via product service_type='milestones'; no separate automated invoice trigger from milestone reach found—milestone marking is a flag (is_reached Boolean)
key_findings.no_hr_expense_project_integration_found: hr_expense integration with project not confirmed in examined modules; not in scope for Community sale_timesheet chain
